title: Re-pitch hears short sounds
thisBuild: Re-pitch now hears sounds as short as a twentieth of a second: clicks, blips, plucks and quick vocal chops. Before, anything under about an eighth of a second got nothing.
It also copes with noisy attacks and notes that die away fast, and it is fussier about long loops, so a loop with one bass note under it goes into the mess's key instead of being moved to C.
Accounts are on: sign in under Settings, Account, and open the same mess on the computer at hubbub0.github.io/Mess-Machine.
watch: Chop something melodic into short slices and tap Re-pitch on a few: does each one land on C?
Try it on a kick or a hat too, and tell me if it moves anything it should leave alone.
limits: A note that slides a long way and never settles (a big 808 drop) still gets nothing.
Some tuned kicks now read as a note, so Re-pitch or Auto-pitch can move them. Undo puts them back.
